content.title: How to watch Phillies vs. Giants: TV channel and streaming options for April 6
content.text: The Philadelphia Phillies and San Francisco Giants clash on Monday at 9:45 p.m. ET, opening a three-game series at Oracle Park. Andrew Painter (1-0, 1.69 ERA) will start for the Phillies, who are 5-4 this season and fourth in the NL East. Adrian Houser (0-1, 1.69 ERA) is expected to start for the Giants, who are 3-7 and fifth in the NL West.How to watch Philadelphia Phillies vs. San Francisco Giants Venue: Oracle Park Time: 9:45 p.m. ET TV: NBCS-BA and NBCS-PH+ Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. He has also tallied five RBIs and has scored four runs. In 35 plate appearances, he has recorded a .303 BA, .343 OBP and .485 SLG with a 5.7% walk rate and a 20% strikeout rate. He has been effective on the base paths, recording one steal on one attempt. In 41 plate appearances, Kyle Schwarber is hitting .188/.366/.531 with a .897 OPS. He has hit three long balls (8th in MLB), driven in six runs and scored four times. San Francisco’s Matt Chapman is slashing .237/.310/.368 this season with one home run, four RBIs and an OPS of .678. He has a 16.7% strikeout rate and a 9.5% walk rate in 42 plate appearances, and he has scored five total runs. In 42 plate appearances, Luis Arraez has hit no long balls, tallied three RBIs and scored three runs. He is batting .275/.286/.350 and has posted a 7.1% strikeout rate and a 2.4% walk rate. Arraez has recorded two steals on two attempts.
